reasons.persona_fit: Accurately addresses the small-business owner-operator in Bareni's calm, practical voice; respects the zero-CTA rule and explicitly preserves one-person consulting identity.
reasons.clarity: The main point that subscription sprawl conceals manual workflow bottlenecks is immediately evident and developed in a logical, structured manner.
reasons.actionability: Provides a practical diagnostic method to map tools, check dependencies, and evaluate recurring tasks against explicit feasibility criteria.
reasons.factual_grounding: Fully grounded in approved evidence, correctly listing out-of-scope tasks, human-approval requirements, and no-lock-in policy without inventing claims or metrics.
